title: Why 95% of East Asians Have Dry Earwax
caption:
One gene decides if your earwax is dry or wet!
A cartoon guy shows off crispy dry earwax, meets a gooey wet swab, and a DNA infographic explains it all.
The ABCC11 gene mutation gives about 95% of East Asians dry earwax, and wet earwax is linked to stronger body odor.
Is your earwax dry and flaky or wet and sticky?
